131        public String pickSubject(String factionId) {
132                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
133                for (String p : ALL_FACTIONS.subjects) {
134                        picker.add(p, 1f);
135                }
136                FactionData data = FACTION_DATA.get(factionId);
137                if (data != null) {
138                        float w = Math.max(1f, data.subjects.length) / Math.max(1f, picker.getTotal());
139                        w *= SPECIFIC_FACTION_SUBJECT_EVENT_LIKELIHOOD; // faction-specific is more likely than generic, overall
140                        for (String p : data.subjects) {
141                                picker.add(p, w);
142                        }
143                }
144                return picker.pick();
145        }
146        
147        public String pickEvent(String factionId) {
148                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
149                for (String event : ALL_FACTIONS.events) {
150                        picker.add(event, 1f);
151                }
152                FactionData data = FACTION_DATA.get(factionId);
153                if (data != null) {
154                        float w = Math.max(1f, data.events.length) / Math.max(1f, picker.getTotal());
155                        w *= SPECIFIC_FACTION_SUBJECT_EVENT_LIKELIHOOD; // faction-specific is more likely than generic, overall
156                        for (String event : data.events) {
157                                picker.add(event, w);
158                        }
159                }
160                return picker.pick();
161        }

168                FAILED_DECIV,

172                BASIC,
173                KANTA,
174        }

191        @Override
192        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
193                // if this mission type was already accepted by the player, abort
194                if (!setGlobalReference("$gaVIP_ref")) {
195                        return false;
196                }
197
198                requireMarketFaction(ALLOWED_FACTIONS.toArray(new String [0]));
199                requireMarketLocationNot("galatia");
200                requireMarketNotHidden();
201                requireMarketNotInHyperspace();
202                preferMarketInDirectionOfOtherMissions();
203                
204//              PROB_KANTA = 1f;
205//              PROB_MERC_KIDNAPPER = 1f;
206                
207                destination = pickMarket();
208                variation = Variation.BASIC;
209                if (rollProbability(PROB_KANTA)) {
210                        MarketAPI kantasDen = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("kantas_den");
211                        if (kantasDen != null) {
212                                destination = kantasDen;
213                                variation = Variation.KANTA;
214                                kantaRelationFirstName = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.PIRATES).createRandomPerson(genRandom).getName().getFirst();
215                        }
216                }
217                if (destination == null) return false;
218                
219                faction = destination.getFaction();
220                subjectRelation = pickSubject(faction.getId());
221                if (subjectRelation == null) return false;
222                
223                event = pickEvent(faction.getId());
224                if (event == null) return false;
225                
226                if (variation == Variation.BASIC) {
227                        target = findOrCreatePerson(faction.getId(), destination, true, Ranks.CITIZEN, 
228                                                        Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR, Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER, Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER,
229                                                        Ranks.POST_OUTPOST_COMMANDER, Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER );
230                        //Ranks.POST_FACTION_LEADER removed
231//                      target.addTag(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
232//                      setPersonIsPotentialContactOnSuccess(target);
233                } else if (variation == Variation.KANTA) {
234                        // set the VIP to Kanta, for rep purposes, since the sub-boss that's the actual relation doesn't exist
235                        PersonDataAPI pd = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getData("kanta");
236                        if (pd != null) target = pd.getPerson();
237                }
238                if (target == null) return false;
239                if (target.hasTag(Tags.NO_RANDOM_MISSIONS)) return false;       
240                
241                system = destination.getStarSystem();
242                
243                setStartingStage(Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
244                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
245                addFailureStages(Stage.FAILED);
246                addNoPenaltyFailureStages(Stage.FAILED_DECIV);
247                
248                // used for generic pirate reaction
249                if (variation == Variation.KANTA) {
250                        setGlobalFlag("$gaVIP_workingForKanta", true, Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
251                }
252                
253                makeImportant(destination, "$gaVIP_target", Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
254                
255                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$gaVIP_delivered");
256                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.FAILED, "$gaVIP_failed");
257                connectWithMarketDecivilized(Stage.DELIVER_VIP, Stage.FAILED_DECIV, destination);
258                
259                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
260                if (variation == Variation.BASIC) {
261                        //setCreditReward(30000, 40000);
262                        setCreditReward(CreditReward.AVERAGE);
263                        setRepPenaltyPerson(RepRewards.VERY_HIGH);
264                        setRepPenaltyFaction(RepRewards.HIGH);
265                } else {
266                        //setCreditReward(50000, 70000);
267                        setCreditReward(CreditReward.HIGH);
268                        setRepPenaltyPerson(RepRewards.EXTREME);
269                        setRepPenaltyFaction(RepRewards.HIGH);
270                }
271                
272                setDefaultGARepRewards();
273                
274//              beginStageTrigger(Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
275//              LocData data = new LocData(EntityLocationType.HIDDEN_NOT_NEAR_STAR, null, system);
276//              triggerSpawnShipGraveyard(Factions.REMNANTS, 10, 10, data);
277//              endTrigger();
278                
279                piratePayment = genRoundNumber(40000, 60000);
280                mercPayment = getCreditsReward() / 2;
281                
282                if (variation == Variation.BASIC && rollProbability(PROB_PIRATE_KIDNAPPER)) {
283                        beginWithinHyperspaceRangeTrigger(destination, 3f, false, Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
284                        triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.HIGHER, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, system);
285                        triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.HIGHER);
286                        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
287                        triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
288                        triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
289                        triggerSetFleetAlwaysPursue();
290                        triggerPickLocationTowardsPlayer(system.getHyperspaceAnchor(), 90f, getUnits(1.5f));
291                        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$gaVIP_pirate", null);
292                        triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer();
293                        triggerFleetMakeImportant(null, Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
294                        endTrigger();
295                }
296                
297                if (variation == Variation.KANTA && rollProbability(PROB_MERC_KIDNAPPER)) {
298                        mercFactionId = pickOne(MERC_FACTIONS.toArray(new String[0]));
299                        FactionAPI mercFaction = Global.getSector().getFaction(mercFactionId);
300                        theMercFaction = mercFaction.getDisplayNameWithArticle();
301                        
302                        beginWithinHyperspaceRangeTrigger(destination, 3f, true, Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
303                        triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.VERY_LARGE, FleetQuality.VERY_HIGH, Factions.MERCENARY, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, system);
304                        triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
305                        triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.HIGHER);
306                        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
307                        triggerMakeHostileAndAggressive();
308                        triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 2, true);
309                        //triggerMakeNoRepImpact(); // this happens in dialog instead
310                        triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
311                        triggerSetFleetAlwaysPursue();
312                        triggerPickLocationTowardsPlayer(system.getHyperspaceAnchor(), 90f, getUnits(1.5f));
313                        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$gaVIP_merc", null);
314                        triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer();
315                        triggerFleetMakeImportant(null, Stage.DELIVER_VIP);
316                        endTrigger();
317                }
318                
319                return true;
320        }
321
322        @Override
323        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params,
324                                                                 Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
325                if (action.equals("betrayal")) {
326                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
327                        e.setDelayMedium();
328                        e.setLocationInnerSector(false, Factions.INDEPENDENT);
329                        e.beginCreate();
330                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.SMOD_3, Factions.MERCENARY, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, new Vector2f());
331                        e.triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.UNUSUALLY_HIGH);
332                        e.triggerFleetSetFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
333                        e.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 2, true);
334                        e.triggerSetFleetFlag("$gaVIP_kantaConsequences");
335                        e.triggerMakeNoRepImpact();
336                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
337                        e.endCreate();
338                        return true;
339                }
340                return false;
341        }

343        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
344                if (getCurrentStage() != null) {
345                        set("$gaVIP_stage", ((Enum)getCurrentStage()).name());
346                }
347                set("$gaVIP_starName", system.getNameWithNoType());
348                set("$gaVIP_marketName", destination.getName());
349                set("$gaVIP_systemName", system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
350                
351                set("$gaVIP_subjectRelation", subjectRelation);
352                set("$gaVIP_kantaRelationFirstName", kantaRelationFirstName);
353                set("$gaVIP_VIP", target);
354                set("$gaVIP_VIP_faction", target.getFaction().getId());
355                set("$gaVIP_VIPName", target.getNameString());
356                set("$gaVIP_VIPhisOrHer", target.getHisOrHer());
357                set("$gaVIP_VIPPost", target.getPost().toLowerCase());
358                set("$gaVIP_event", event);
359                
360                set("$gaVIP_reward", Misc.getWithDGS(getCreditsReward()));
361                set("$gaVIP_piratePayment", Misc.getWithDGS(piratePayment));
362                set("$gaVIP_mercPayment", Misc.getWithDGS(mercPayment));
363                set("$gaVIP_theMercFaction", theMercFaction);
364                set("$gaVIP_mercFactionId", mercFactionId);
365                set("$gaVIP_timeLimit", (int)MISSION_DAYS);
366                set("$gaVIP_variation", variation);
367        }

369        @Override
370        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
371                float opad = 10f;
372                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
373                if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_VIP) {
374                        if (variation == Variation.BASIC) {
375                                info.addPara("Deliver the " + subjectRelation + " of " + target.getNameString() + " to " + 
376                                                destination.getName() + " in the " + system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort() + ", for " +
377                                                event + ". " +
378                                                target.getNameString() + " is the " + target.getPost().toLowerCase() + ".", opad);
379                        } else if (variation == Variation.KANTA) {
380                                info.addPara("Deliver the " + subjectRelation + " of " + kantaRelationFirstName + " Kanta to " + 
381                                                destination.getName() + " in the " + system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort() + ", for " +
382                                                event + ". " +
383                                                kantaRelationFirstName + " is kin to Kanta herself.", opad);
384                        }
385                }
386        }

388        @Override
389        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
390                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
391                if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_VIP) {
392                        info.addPara("Deliver student to " + destination.getName() + " in the " + system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), tc, pad);
393                        return true;
394                }
395                return false;
396        }
